turns.text: Okay, everyone's on. Mom's been home since Thursday and the papers are on the counter.

turns.text: The metoprolol bottle says fifty but the sheet says twenty-five. I'll call the pharmacy about it this afternoon.

turns.text: Who's going to sort out the shower chair?

turns.text: Maybe I will look at the bills on the weekend.

turns.text: I'm going to keep my pills in the kitchen where I can see them.
